notes.title: Patch Notes November 9, 2024
notes.content:
Trying to implement Steam Cloud saves.

If you lose all your data, you can unlock levels by going into the game's data folder, find the persistentdata.txt file and change the "MaxLevelUnlocked" value.

Yesterday's patch introduced a few issues.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Dec 30, 2022
notes.content:
-New particle systems for bullets, enemy explosions, collisions, etc,!!!
-Bullets are bigger so it will be easier to hit enemies now.
-Item hit boxes are larger so that they are easier to collect now.
-A lot of general maintenance and performance fixes.
-The game should look and feel a bit better to play now.

notes.title: Patch Notes October 23, 2022
notes.content:
This patch includes

-Updated game feel for barrel rolls and special abilities.

notes.title: Update Notes for October 3, 2022
notes.content:
Three major parts to this update:
1) All of the blasters and abilities have been modified to improve performance.
2) Blasters will now regress if you take damage.
3) A bunch of graphical performance improvements. These don't really affect quality, but the game runs more smoothly on lower end hardware.

This is probably the most difficult version of the game released to date. Please bare with me. I'll make it a bit easier in the future.

notes.title: Patch for January 7, 2022
notes.content:
Happy New Year!

This patch reduces the amount of particle systems and includes some other minor performance improvements to the code base.

The Linux build now uses LZ4HC compression which may result in performance improvements as well. 

This will make the gameplay experience better for older hardware.

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
1) Completely new procedural generation engine
2) Added two new instructions screens
3) Added two new items: score bonus and score multiplier
4) Item visual effects updated
5) Levels 1-30 are now accessible
6) Removed some redundant files. Program size is ~200 MB
7) Updated warning screen
8) Updated credits screen

Updates will become more regular for the foreseeable future (hopefully every day or two).

notes.title: Update in Progress
notes.content: Doing a massive overhaul on the way levels are generated in the game. This will make it easier to add more content to the game. Expect to see a major update to the product in about two weeks. Two new items will be included with the next update. These will be a score bonus item and a score multiplier bonus item.
